attempts.action: Restart the Docker container, then query migration history
attempts.safeResult: The approved tmpfs was cleared by the container restart, so the migration schema was absent. No persistence claim was made.

attempts.action: Restart PostgreSQL with pg_ctl inside the same container
attempts.safeResult: PostgreSQL is PID 1 in the approved image. Stopping it exited the container before pg_ctl could restart it; the environment verifier denied the stopped state.

invariant: Restart-persistence proof must not weaken tmpfs, relabel reload as restart, or hide either failed attempt.
requiredNextDecision: Approve a separately reviewed persistence-capable disposable harness, such as an ephemeral Docker volume with fail-closed ownership and teardown controls. Do not weaken or remove the check to obtain PASS.
